label: Irish Moiled

about.text: The Irish Moiled is a rare, hornless (polled) dual-purpose cattle breed from Ireland, kept for both milk and beef. It is one of Ireland's oldest native breeds and recovered from a near-collapse in the late 20th century through breeder efforts.

facts.v: By the late 1970s the pedigree herd in Northern Ireland was down to about thirty breeding females and two bulls, and the Rare Breeds Survival Trust listed the breed as critical in 1979.
